title: How to Use Concealed Text Fields in Business Central AL
summary: Business Central 27.1 introduces Concealed Text Fields, which mask sensitive data during input to prevent shoulder surfing and screen captures. Developers can enable this feature through Feature Management and apply the MaskType property to Code, Text, Decimal, and Integer fields.
key_points: Concealed Text Fields mask user input to protect against shoulder surfers and screen captures
Feature requires Business Central 27.1 and must be activated via Feature Management
Developers set MaskType = Concealed on field definitions in AL code
Works with Code, Text, Decimal, and Integer field types
Complements existing security tools like SecretText and Isolated Storage

quotes.text: Business Central 27.1 introduces the Concealed Text Field to solve this problem!
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates the exact version where this security feature became available

quotes.text: This will work on Code, Text, Decimal, and Integer fields.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the scope of field types that support the Concealed masking feature
